Marta Wojcik  
Email: marta.wojcik@nexugames.com | Tel: +972-52-123-4567 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/marta-wojcik | Address: Tel Aviv, Israel  

Professional Summary  
A seasoned product manager with a decade of experience shaping digital experiences in the gaming industry. My career has been defined by bridging creative vision and operational execution, with a focus on delivering player-centric solutions that align with business objectives. Over the past 10 years, I have led cross-functional teams through complex development cycles, from early-stage prototyping to large-scale global launches. My approach combines rigorous analytical thinking with a deep understanding of user behavior, enabling me to drive decisions that balance innovation with measurable outcomes.  

Professional Experience  
**NexuGames** | Staff Product Manager (2018–Present)  
Oversaw the full lifecycle of a AAA open-world title, coordinating 10+ internal teams and external partners to meet a $25M budget. Spearheaded the integration of dynamic storytelling systems, which increased player retention by 18% in the first month post-launch. Collaborated with stakeholders to refine monetization strategies, resulting in a 22% improvement in average revenue per user. Chaired biweekly cross-team syncs to align priorities and resolve technical debt, reducing feature delivery delays by 30%.  

**Vortex Interactive** | Product Specialist (2016–2018)  
Led user research initiatives for a battle royale game, identifying key pain points in matchmaking systems. This work informed the redesign of queue algorithms, which reduced player frustration by 25% and increased session duration by 15%. Conducted competitive analysis against three major titles, producing a strategic roadmap that guided feature prioritization and secured a 12% boost in early-stage user acquisition.  

**PixelForge Studios** | Junior Product Coordinator (2013–2016)  
Supported the documentation of feature requirements for mobile game titles, ensuring alignment between design and development teams. Played a pivotal role in the launch of a free-to-play puzzle game, contributing to a 40% increase in monthly active users within the first quarter.  

Projects  
**AAA Open-World Title (NexuGames, 2018–2021)**  
Managed the integration of a persistent world system, coordinating with artists, engineers, and narrative designers to ensure seamless player progression. Introduced a phased rollout strategy for in-game events, which extended player engagement by 20% and reduced server load by 15%.  

**Battle Royale Optimization (Vortex Interactive, 2017)**  
Designed and executed A/B tests to evaluate player feedback on loot distribution mechanics. The resulting adjustments increased player satisfaction scores by 14% and reduced churn rates by 9% in the following quarter.  

Technical Skills  
- **SQL analytics**: Analyzed player behavior data to inform feature prioritization, including tracking conversion rates for in-game purchases.  
- **A/B testing**: Conducted experiments on UI/UX elements, such as menu navigation and tutorial flow, to optimize user onboarding.  
- **Competitive analysis**: Maintained a quarterly review of industry trends, producing reports that guided product direction and market positioning.  
- **Roadmap planning**: Developed quarterly release plans that balanced short-term goals with long-term vision, ensuring alignment across departments.  
- **Stakeholder management**: Facilitated communication between design, engineering, and marketing teams, resolving conflicts and aligning priorities.  
- **UX research**: Led ethnographic studies to uncover player motivations, which informed the design of a core gameplay mechanic.  
- **Agile/Scrum**: Implemented daily standups and sprint retrospectives to improve team velocity, reducing iteration cycles by 25%.  
- **Product management**: Architected the product lifecycle for three major titles, mentoring junior managers and establishing best practices for cross-team collaboration.
